scientific_integrity: The proof uses explicit path matrices, cyclic binary support, and affine–torus cells. Exhaustive tests cover eight finite configurations; independent external validation and comprehensive historical publication-priority audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies left/right regular multipliers only for nilpotent radical elements of oriented cyclic path algebras kQ_n/I^3 with n>=3. Other nilpotency lengths, diagonal elements, general Kupisch series, and nonreduced closures are not treated.
title: Jordan-type gaps and a motivic transfer census for cyclic Nakayama radicals
